content: The Boon for the Khan (Tuḥfa-yi khānī) of the title is ʿAlī Ṣafī's 1522 manual, commissioned by Durmish Khān Shāmlū, Qizilbash governor of Khurasan; on the pages read (pdf 1-10) the article uses commission and patron language for that book only, and does not describe Ibn Turka's own patronage as commissioned boons or as transactional.
